## Hosting a wedding at home in Delhi? Here's how self-storage in Delhi helps family's clear space for guests, decorators, and the celebration itself.


One benefit of **[self storage in Delhi](https://stownest.com/self-storage-delhi?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=Self+storage+delhi)** is that it helps families make space for home wedding decorations by removing home furniture. Traditionally, our company had to move furniture to an isolated storage room, where it was left to gather dust. With the beginning and end of the wedding season as the demarcating limits, furniture is moved to and from a storage facility in Delhi.


## **A Delhi Wedding Takes Over the Whole House**


A traditional Hindu wedding in Delhi is a months-long process consisting of multiple functions and events. Relatives visit for days on end. For extended periods of time, a household can be in 'wedding mode'. During these periods, various parts of the household can be converted to make space for different events. Relatives also need a place to stay.


For an event, it is necessary to move all the furniture in a house to other places. A typical house has a dining set and a sofa set. For an event, these have to be removed. Unfortunately, we have not been able to think of a better way of solving this problem.


Furniture is moved to one of the bedrooms. This creates a lot of space, but is temporarily safe and secure only for a day or two. If decorators don't have space to set up for an event, guests have no place to eat, and relaxation becomes very difficult.


## **Why This Becomes a Real Logistics Problem**


Decorating for weddings in Delhi means bringing in a lot of temporary structures for seating and lighting, which requires a lot of open space. For decorators, an already furnished living room is less convenient, as there is a higher chance that something will get bumped over while setting up. Relatives and friends of the family also need a place to stay during the functions. Often, the only empty room is the one already used for storage of all the furniture.


## **How Self Storage in Delhi Solves This Cleanly**


Clearing larger pieces of furniture out of your house by putting them in storage in Delhi makes more space in your home for decorating and for the movement of guests. Tables and seating that are not needed during the event can be put in storage.


Renting storage in Delhi during the weeks prior to a wedding and subsequent events means storage and removal of furniture can be coordinated with the events. Furniture storage is returned after the events and the storage window is closed.


## **Why This Beats the Usual Workarounds**


Furniture in just one room of the house becomes a major risk during a wedding. It gets ruined because of improper stacking against walls. Door frames get ruined because of furniture getting stacked against them. In the process, the entire room becomes useless. It is best to hire a **[furniture storage service in Delhi](https://stownest.com/self-storage-delhi?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=Self+storage+delhi)** because then the furniture will not get ruined and the room will be available for other tasks related to the wedding.


## **Who This Actually Helps Most**


This usually affects families more who host wedding functions at their houses rather than a banquet hall. It also affects families who expect out-of-town relatives to stay at their house during the wedding. It affects families who work with decorators who need wide-open space to work with rather than half-done work because of obstacles in the room.


## **A Wedding Should Fill The House With Celebration, Not Furniture**


Organizing a wedding in Delhi is a daunting task as it is with all the different functions to manage, not to mention your relatives and guests. When you should be enjoying your own celebrations you end up worrying about where to keep the sofa and other bulky furniture. Moving your heavy furniture to a **[self storage unit near you](https://stownest.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=Self+storage+delhi)** is the best solution. This will help you utilize your space optimally to celebrate your special day.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**1. How does using self storage in Delhi allow you to host a wedding in your home?**


Self storage in Delhi gives you the opportunity to free up space in your home by moving bulky furniture to a storage facility. This gives you sufficient space to accommodate your decorators and guests.


**2. Are there storage facilities in Delhi that provide storage services on an event basis, for instance storage services for a wedding?**


Yes, several storage facilities provide storage services for events, including StowNest.


**3. When does furniture storage in Delhi become available?**


Storage services become available as early as the time leading up to the first function. Storage services are suspended during the function and resume after the wedding.


**4. Does temporary storage in Delhi for a few weeks during the wedding season become a long statement in my pocket?**


Not really, Several storage facilities provide "pay per use" services. This means you only pay for the services for the period you require storage.


**5. Is my furniture secure in a storage facility in Delhi?**
